payload.input: In split_lines.sh, change only the line `IFS=,` to `IFS=$'\n'` so the fields are split on newlines instead of commas. Do not change any other line.

#!/usr/bin/env bash$
# split_lines.sh: print every field of the first argument on its own line$
IFS=read -r -a parts <<< "$1"$
for p in "${parts[@]}"; do$
  echo "[$p]"$
done$
\n'$
